reason: The repeat-outage thing still stings, so surfacing old postmortems before a change is honestly the part that caught my eye. But a hosted 'early preview' that wants read access to our Slack, Drive and GitHub is not getting through our security review this month, and our agents aren't touching anything risky enough yet to make me fight procurement for it.
objection: You're asking for our entire Slack, Drive, GitHub and Notion history on a product that calls itself early preview. I'd have to answer to security for where that data goes and who can see it, and 'every answer shows its sources' doesn't tell me anything about access controls or audit logs.
would_change_my_mind: A SOC 2 report plus permission-aware retrieval that respects our existing Slack/Drive ACLs, or one of my engineers self-hosting it and showing me it would have flagged the postmortem behind our last repeat outage.
